skills.name: refactor-scan
skills.description: Use when the user asks to scan for refactoring opportunities, e.g. "refactor scan", "find duplication or code smells in my recent commits", "scan this package for refactors", "audit the whole codebase for refactoring", or "resume the refactor scan"; scans a diff, package, or full codebase and files reviewable findings as beads issues.

commands.name: refactor-scan
commands.description: Scan code for refactoring opportunities. [--scope diff|package|all] [--base <sha>] [--fresh]

agents.description: Scans committed code diffs for refactoring opportunities in three passes (structural similarity, code smells and SOLID/DRY violations, language idioms) and returns candidates for the validator agent.
Correlates raw refactoring candidates from scanner shards into architectural root-cause findings and writes a reviewable findings.md; filing issues is the validator's job.
Validates refactoring candidates from the scanner agent: reads the source to confirm similarity, checks test coverage, deduplicates against beads issues, and files TDD-first refactoring issues.
